DATE-SENSITIVE MATCHING (mandatory): the registry holds multiple captures of the same query at different dates; a recovered transcript is matched to an entry by query AND capture date (thread date bounds the capture date from above), and where the date cannot be established from the thread, the transcript is seated with transcript_provenance noting the ambiguity and the entry match is confirmed with MANUS before write. Never match on query alone. OCR-PROBE CLASS (MANUS, 2026-08-11): for image-bearing captures whose pastes were output-only (input copy blocked), the probe is the capture's own first full sentence, OCR'd from the first screenshot (tesseract, dark-mode inversion, Al→AI normalization; 1.8 s/image benchmarked, full-registry pass ≈10 min). Probe strings are stored per queue row as ocr_probe; exact-match conversation_search on the probe locates the paste-bearing thread even when 'You said:' and the footer are absent. OCR text is for SEARCH ONLY — never seated as transcript; the seated text always comes verbatim from the thread paste.

overwrite_finding: MANUS reports transcripts were present at some point and specifically overwritten; repo-history exact-match trawl (git log -S on both footers, all fleet repos, full histories) returns ZERO hits — full pastes never reached any commit. The loss is therefore session-side: pastes were condensed into write-ups before data entry. Standing consequence: from v9.41 the transcript field is a completeness requirement, and the paste is seated verbatim BEFORE any write-up prose is composed.
verification_rule: SEAT VERIFICATION (ratified 2026-08-11 after MANUS called the spot check): every seated transcript is checked against OCR of its own screenshots. >=35% token coverage → meta.transcript_verification records image-corroborated with the percentage; below that the seat is UNSEATED and returned to the description, because low coverage means the extractor pulled ANALYST prose rather than composed-answer text. Entries with no image evidence are marked unverified rather than assumed good. The registry never claims a transcript the evidence does not support. TWO-TEST STANDARD (extended 2026-08-11 at MANUS's challenge): image corroboration is the primary test, run against ALL screenshots not a sample. Where images cannot corroborate — none held, or they capture a different surface than the seated text — a REGISTER TEST decides: composed-answer markers (definitional register, 'Would you like', bracketed source numbers, the platform footer, 'Key/Core Concepts') versus analyst markers (bold shouted findings, deposit numbers, AXN forms, 'the composition layer', 'longitudinal pair'). A seat passes only if it reads as machine output. Failing both tests, the seat is marked unconfirmed and becomes a thread-trawl priority — it is NOT silently counted as a transcript.
